## Highlights
Showing the 12 most recent highlights from 20 user-facing changes.
### New
- Configure available WebKit feature flags from Crest settings - Use customized browser keyboard shortcuts on iPhone and iPad
### Improved
- Allow pages to use high-refresh-rate displays by default while keeping experimental scroll animation optional - Show credential fill suggestions beside the field that requested them
### Fixed
- Prevent iCloud Sync from re-uploading acknowledged browsing records and repeatedly triggering throttling - Keep Peek cards clear of their control bar - Keep the iPhone page viewport stable when the keyboard opens Find - Focus the Find query field every time Find is requested - Keep pinned and saved tabs safe unless a deliberate deletion is confirmed - Close an iPhone Peek from its button or by tapping outside the card - Reveal the sidebar in the correct window position after an upward swipe - Keep the Space strip responsive when a staged drag is not claimed
---
Nightly builds contain the newest changes and may be less reliable than stable releases.

# Crest stable release
[Download Crest for Mac (Apple silicon)](https://github.com/pauljoda/Crest/releases/download/v0.4.0/Installer-Crest-0.4.0-arm64.dmg)
Built from [`25e75fd`](https://github.com/pauljoda/Crest/commit/25e75fd77a6d1ff2f5828b1d55004439d6b6515f).
This release is signed and notarized for direct distribution.
## Changes in this build
### chore(release): prepare 0.4.0
Crest 0.4 adds Split View across Mac, iPhone, and iPad; expands standards-based extension support across Chrome, Firefox, and Safari-created packages; and establishes signed, notarized direct updates through Sparkle.
It also includes the Space, tab, drag-and-drop, navigation, favicon, sync, retention, and WebKit compatibility fixes collected in the 0.4.0 changelog.
